proposals.current: Imports tables attached to an OMERO image as ImageJ table. Please note that OMERO tables have a wider range of allowed data types, while ImageJ only supports numeric and string columns. Any unsupported table object is converted into a string.
proposals.proposed: Downloads a table attached to an OMERO image and imports it as an ImageJ table. Please note that OMERO tables have a wider range of allowed data types, while ImageJ only supports numeric and string columns. Any unsupported table object is converted into a string.

proposals.current: Returns the ID(s) of dataset(s) according to search criteria. Requires project IDs as input. This algorithm merges all annotations and data annotations. Use the iteration step settings to determine how annotations and data annotations are merged
proposals.proposed: Lists the OMERO datasets that match the search criteria and returns their IDs. Requires project IDs as input.
